notes.title: Expanded Star Lounge is Here! With Free Access!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558916/2a267c83c5f697b678d290a51b8b7733e16f02bc.png"][/img][b]Hey there space travellers![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Our major update is here soon and we are going big! With new games, new spaces to play around with your friends, we are making your experience more fun, and also allow us to expand our universe even further. We hope you will enjoy it when it comes out. [/p][p][/p][p][b]And the expansion will come out for free![/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Stay tuned![/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Visual Update & Bugfixes!
notes.notes: [h2]Patch 1.0.1 will include:[/h2][h3]Visual Updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new playable area called "Planetarium", which replaces the old "Travelbubble" location used for playing different games.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a new Lounge area as a replacement for the old "Travelbubble" location.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new highlights to the "Travelbubbles".[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the flight paths of the ships flying in the background.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "Hole indicator" for all finish holes in the "Golf" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the placement of rocks in the "Fourth of Switzerland" area within the "Golf" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the lighting and shadow quality in the "Space Lounge".[/p][/*][*][p]Added new billboard ad.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when quitting the game using the "Quit Game" button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when pressing the "Alt + F4" shortcut.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred after a server disconnect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred during network errors in multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when pressing the home button in the Hand Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred during multiplayer sessions in the "Hovercraft" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that occurred after a certain amount of time while playing the "Hovercraft" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where the teleporter could not reach certain areas.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]Improved performance in the "Hovercraft" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the performance of Bonus Target spawning in the "Archery" game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Cosmic Star Lounge is now OUT!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558916/be1dfde386e4653f4b65358b8779079afbb30434.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]HELLLLLLOOOOO EVERYONE!! [/p][p][/p][p]The big day has come and we are today releasing Cosmic Star Lounge! For celebration, we are now live on Twitch and Youtube! Feel free to drop by! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/baxverse"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://youtube.com/@CosmicStarLounge"]https://youtube.com/@CosmicStarLounge[/url]

During the development of one year we have received countless of support from you all and everyone around us. As the developers of CSL, we give you so many thanks, as many as the stars above! 

What will be next? MORE UPDATES! We will release countless of new content, new games, cosmetics and expansions, starting soon. VERY SOON! SO STAY TUNED FOR MORE! [/p][p][/p][p]THANK YOU! AND SEE YOU OUT THERE![/p][p][/p]
